events.name: Agricultural and Mechanics Association of Pennsylvania and New Jersey: stock subscribers
events.description: The constitution and stock book of the Agricultural and Mechanics Association of Pennsylvania and New Jersey, dated 'Philadelphia 1839 - May first.' Shares cost $10. Article Sixth: the treasurer keeps the accounts and pays orders signed by the chairman of the board of managers and countersigned by the secretary; Article Seventh: no transfer of shares except on the books of the Association. Subscribers as written: Ralph Smith, one share, and again eight shares; Jacob C. White, five shares; treasurer of the Association; Edwin H. Coates, one share; Daniel Colley, one share; Robert B. Ayres, one share; James McCrummell, three shares; Stephen H. Gloucester, two shares; John B. Roberts, one share; Charles James, one share; Thomas J. White, two shares; Thomas Banks, one share; Jesse Turner, one share; Nathaniel W. Depee, two shares; Sarah McCrummell, one share; Elizabeth A. Henley, one share; Catherine McCrummill, one share; Elizabeth Colly, one share; William H. Wilson, one share; Peter Lester, one share; N. G. Boston, one share; Rebecca Lambsong, one share; Thomas Jones, two shares; Sam Sharp, one share; Augustus Thomas, one share; Arthur Boyer, one share; Solomon Nelson, one share; Rendal Smith, one share; Peter Jackson, one share; J. J. G. Bias, one share; Mrs. Bias, one share; Ruth Harding, one share; David Berton, one share; Alexander Guy, one share; Clayton Miller, one share; Shepherd Shay, one share; John Douglass, one share; Charles H. Bustill, one share; Cyrus B. Miller, one share; Edith Miller, one share; Levi Davis, one share; Jesse E. Glasgow, two shares; James Gibbins, one share; Charles A. Roxborough, one share; Samuel C. Hutchins, two shares; Philip Thompson, one share; B. H. Henderson, one share; Frederick Woodson, one share; Stephen Purnell, one share. Also on the list: William Nichwals, five shares, and Corr, two shares (no first name written). A crossed-out name sits above S. H. Gloucester. Source: Agricultural and Mechanics Association of Pennsylvania and New Jersey, constitution and stock book, Leon Gardiner Collection, Historical Society of Pennsylvania (photographed by Michiko Quinones). Photographs of the stock book taken by Michiko Quinones at HSP: manuscripts/AMAPNJ_1839/HSP_LGC_AMAPNJ_stockbook_1.jpg manuscripts/AMAPNJ_1839/HSP_LGC_AMAPNJ_stockbook_2.jpg manuscripts/AMAPNJ_1839/HSP_LGC_AMAPNJ_stockbook_3.jpg See also the 1838 Black Metropolis blog post 'Finding Black-led creation and use of economic instruments to support freedom seekers in 1840': https://www.1838blackmetropolis.com/site/post/finding-black-led-creation-and-use-of-economic-instruments-to-support-freedom-seekers-in-1840/
